fullDescription: An industrial and clean news section design inspired by maritime and logistics aesthetics. It features a primary forest green color palette (#007651), a minimalist 1px grid system, and heavy emphasis on uppercase typography with wide letter spacing. The design uses grayscale imagery with monochromatic overlays to maintain a professional, cohesive brand feel. Suitable for corporate news, logistics portfolios, industrial blogs, and sustainability reports.
prompt:
## Resumo
A corporate news grid component featuring a three-column layout with 1px borders, grayscale imagery with dark green overlays, and bold, uppercase typography. The aesthetic is professional, technical, and high-contrast.

## Estilo Visual
Use 'Open Sans' for all typography. Primary color: Forest Green (#007651); Text secondary: rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.6); Grid lines: #d1ede1; Dark Overlay: rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.4). 

### Typography Specs:
- Section Label: 10px, Black (weight 900), 3px tracking, uppercase, Forest Green.
- Hero Heading: 48px, Black (weight 900), -1.2px tracking, uppercase, slate-950.
- Card Title: 18px, Bold (weight 700), -0.45px tracking, slate-900.
- Card Body: 14px, Medium (weight 500), 20px leading, rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.6).
- Metadata: 10px, Black (weight 900), 2px tracking, uppercase, rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.4).
- CTA Text: 12px, Black (weight 900), 2.4px tracking, uppercase, Forest Green.

### Animation:
- Card Image: On hover, scale from 1.0 to 1.05 over 500ms (ease-in-out).
- CTA Arrow: On card hover, translate-x by 4px over 300ms.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Section
Create a header section with a max-width of 1280px. Left side contains a small tag line with a leading slash '/' in Forest Green. Below it, a large two-word uppercase title where the second word is Forest Green. Right side contains a 'View All' button aligned to the baseline of the title. Spacing below header: 80px.

### News Grid
Implement a grid using `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` on desktop and 1 column on mobile. Set the grid container background to #d1ede1 and card gaps to 1px. Ensure the grid has an outer 1px border of the same color.

### News Card
Each card has a white background and two main sections: a fixed-height media container (256px) and a content area with 32px padding. Media container features a grayscale image, a dark green overlay (rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.4)), and a category badge in the top-left (padding 8px 16px). Content area follows a Title -> Paragraph -> Footer (Date and 'Read More') vertical flow.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Industrial Category Badge — A high-contrast label placed over images.
Small rectangular badge with background #007651 and white text. Font-size 10px, Black weight, 2px letter spacing, uppercase. Positioned absolute at top: 24px, left: 24px.

### Grid-Border News Card — A card designed to work within a 1px gap grid system.
Standard white background block. Image container uses `overflow: hidden` to mask the scale animation of the grayscale img element. The grayscale filter must be 100%. The footer of the card uses `display: flex` with `justify-content: space-between` and `align-items: center` to separate the metadata and the CTA.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the 1px grid line separation for the industrial look. MUST use grayscale filters on all images with the specified green overlay to ensure text legibility and brand consistency. DO NOT use rounded corners; the design relies on sharp 90-degree angles. MUST ensure the 'Read More' text and arrow move together on hover of the entire card, not just the text link.

style.description: The style is characterized by its high-contrast industrial look, utilizing 'Open Sans' across various weights (Black, Bold, Medium). The palette is anchored by a deep Forest Green (#007651) and a very dark Green-Black (slate-950). Layout elements are separated by thin 1px lines in a pale mint green (#d1ede1). Animations include subtle image scaling and horizontal translations of call-to-action arrows.
